method: Production root with public fictional world. Three isolated contexts per viewport for cold HTTP/SW caches, followed by same-context reload after verified Service Worker control. CDP emulates 150ms latency and 1.6Mbps down/0.75Mbps up; no CPU throttling. No Playwright routing (which would disable HTTP cache). FCP is browser Paint Timing; world ready is observed from the actual scene state. No slow samples removed.
